stage: Versioned foundation; runtime cases must later bind actual source/API and frozen binary

criteria.required: Positive bounded canonical integer steps/cycles, checked products/sums before allocation. N20,T200 uniform20x10; N20,T375 balanced [18,19,19,19]x5. Explicit preserves order and sum. Unknown enum/zero cycles/extraneous incompatible policy fields refuse.
Exact decimal/rational seconds conversion, if exposed, refuses .25/.75s. Do not silently round; no CoverAtLeast enabled. Overflow and over-max requests refuse before loops/allocation.

New immutable hard envelope; custom policies may tighten but cannot grow caps. All current/future allocation/output admission binds case plan and cumulative batch ledger. Preflight hash or empty identity does not construct Model.

Numeric live slots released once, transfers are move-only. Strong failure behavior: overflow/failed reserve does not refund earlier cumulative charges or leak live ownership; failed operations and case changes cannot bypass batch cap. Resizing charges old+new while both exist, capacity reuse no artificial new charge. Lifetime of outstanding owners is valid after wrapper move/destruction. Enforce the hard tracked-live cap across all outstanding reservations in one batch, including tickets whose original case wrapper has been destroyed; shared ownership must not allow overlapping cases to bypass it.

q/v/C/w length7 finite, independent physical and accepted histories; q strict original joint range, C original control domain, w closed +/- .0625, progress s[0,1],r[0,.2]. No clipping or C=q/w=v replacement. Preserve separate previous alpha/b, finite histories; original alpha envelope applies to candidate inputs.

Same completed tick and command sequence plus observer association, explicit completed/inflight status and finite bounded age. Snapshot and nominal anchor exact packed equality and boundary. Mismatch, stale, unknown tags or invalid dimensions refuse before any usable request.

Pure preview from current accepted history using w_next=w+.004*alpha; C_next=C+.004*w_next, s_next=s+.004*r+.5*.004*.004*b and r_next=r+.004*b. Controls finite/original domains; complete next command/progress domain checked. No coarse-cell-duration substitution, measured-v substitution, physical prediction or supervisor application. Preserve candidate alpha separately from preview acceleration reconstructed through the literal rounded w difference; preview jerk uses reconstructed preview acceleration and previous accepted alpha, not candidate substitution.

Finite explicitly shifted algebra state can include negative r. It carries no LiveActualContext or usable command API; cannot forge live context by aggregate/default construction. Prior FD/model failures remain unaffected.

Source/build/XML/constants/SDK identity truthful and verified against actual file bytes; hash strings only are not a genuine live Model witness or runtime permission. Unreviewed arbitrary path/content cannot masquerade as pinned model. Do not impersonate oldF1 binary. Original Model construction/metadata/rollout separately gated.

New target independent, old frozen sources/profile limits unchanged. No accidental link-time/global/static Model construction. Complete source manifest plus all revisions, exact no-run scope, no controller readiness or phase acceptance. Reviewer records source-only limits and prerequisite remaining factory/normalization/algebra/capture work.
